notes: Gold is authored from the fixture source alone, before any context_for_task code exists, and must be independently reviewed before it is hashed into the PLAN-462 gate manifest.
Symbol ids are '<path>::<selector>' with Go methods as '(*Recv).Method' or 'Recv.Method'. The harness maps them to index nodes through topology.ResolveNodes with a path hint.
mode 'known-seed' measures packing capacity from explicit seeds. Mode 'discovery' starts from a file seed plus task prose, and the gold includes symbols outside the seed files (residual).
required_labels are truthful-partial disclosures the pack must carry. forbidden lists content or behaviour the pack must never contain.

residual is derived, not hand-picked: gold items (bodies, related, constraints, gap_candidates, members) whose file is not a declared seed file. validate_cases.py recomputes it and fails on disagreement. Only mode 'discovery' cases count toward headline expansion recall; known-seed residual is a capacity diagnostic.

cases.task: Change Apply so percentage discounts round half up. Which callers and tests are affected?
required_labels: receiver-method call sites unresolved: an empty or short caller list is not proof of no callers
forbidden: claiming api.Checkout is unaffected
cases.gold_rationale: Checkout reaches Total only through a method call on a plain copy of a parameter (cc := c; cc.Total()), which the call resolver leaves unresolved: it links a call on the method's own receiver, on a parameter of a named type, or on a local variable the function declares once with an evident type (T{}, &T{}, new(T), var x T, a function's declared result), but a plain copy gives the variable no evident type. The sole route is a reverse import edge (api imports cart), so the pack must surface Checkout as a labelled gap candidate via reverse-import expansion, never as a resolved caller. Slice A must implement reverse-import gap expansion or this case fails by construction.

cases.task: Change Off so percentage discounts round half up. Which callers are affected?
required_labels: same-package callers are call sites in sibling files of the package that name the declaration, matched by name and not resolved by the call graph (e1, heuristic)
forbidden: presenting the name match as a resolved edge, or counting it among the resolved callers
stating that Off has no callers
cases.gold_rationale: Tenth and TestOffPercent call Off on a local Discount from sibling files of the same package; each function declares that local twice (`var d Discount` and a `d := Discount{}` in an inner scope). The call graph resolves a bare same-package call (Savings calls Apply), a call on the method's own receiver, a call on a parameter of a named type and a call on a local variable the function declares once with an evident type, but a name declared twice is ambiguous (the index holds no scopes), so the only route is the recorded call site: it is a same-package name match at evidence 1, labelled as such, never a resolved caller. C16 first seeded the function Apply and its bare-call caller Savings; once the index resolved bare same-package calls that caller became a derived edge and the name search skips functions, so the case moved to a method whose callers stay unresolved; once the index also resolved a local declared once, the callers moved to a local declared twice, which both declarations still show to be a Discount.

required_labels: same-package callers are call sites in sibling files of the package that name the declaration, matched by name and not resolved by the call graph (e1, heuristic)
forbidden: admitting a call on a receiver nothing identifies as a Cart at evidence 1
cases.gold_rationale: Both tests call c.Total() on a local Cart that the test declares twice (`var c Cart` and a re-declaration of c in a subtest): the call graph cannot tell which declaration a call sees, so it leaves the call unresolved, but the caller's own declarations are the receiver evidence a method needs, as every one of them gives c the type Cart. A method call whose receiver has no evident type is only an evidence-0 gap candidate.

languages.go: structure + Go-only syntactic cross-file call graph (package-qualified calls, bare same-package calls, own-receiver calls, calls on a parameter of a named type and calls on a local variable declared once with an evident type resolve; calls on a name declared more than once, a plain copy, a field chain or a returned value are unresolved)
